import html # Predefined HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the provided user input safely. Parameters ---------- client_input : str Content supplied by the user that should be inserted into the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with user content safely escaped. """ if not isinstance(client_input, str): raise TypeError("client_input must be a string") # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent script injection. safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
